hyp_1.title: Telemetry tracking loss
hyp_1.explanation: Client-side event tracking dropped events so reported metrics fell.

history.reason: Under active analysis; evidence ev_1_e38b recorded (supports).
event_volume_check result supports the hypothesis (independent volume view agrees with the first finding) [rule: 2+ supporting items from 2+ analyses, significant after correction]

hyp_2.title: Code regression in a release
hyp_2.explanation: A recent release introduced a bug that broke part of checkout.

history.reason: release_did result contradicts the hypothesis (no significant difference-in-differences (DiD=0.00346, p=0.945))

hyp_3.title: Traffic mix shift
hyp_3.explanation: The mix of arriving users shifted toward lower-converting segments.

history.reason: mix_shift_decomposition result contradicts the hypothesis (mix effect 0.000498 explains little of -0.016)

hyp_4.title: Third-party outage
hyp_4.explanation: An external payment dependency failed for a short period.

history.reason: error_analysis result contradicts the hypothesis (only routine card declines)

hyp_5.title: Seasonality or calendar effect
hyp_5.explanation: The comparison window covers weekends or holidays that are normally quieter.

history.reason: seasonal_baseline result contradicts the hypothesis (deviation from same-weekday baseline remains (p=9.43e-11) or no weekday pattern (p=0.772))

hyp_6.title: Natural variation
hyp_6.explanation: The change is within normal day-to-day variation of the metric.

history.reason: change_point result contradicts the hypothesis (a change point exists (p=0.002))

hyp_7.title: Pricing or policy change
hyp_7.explanation: A price or policy change reduced conversion.

hyp_8.title: Gradual cohort decay
hyp_8.explanation: Retention is eroding gradually across cohorts.

history.reason: retention_comparison result contradicts the hypothesis (retention is stable)
